symptom: ako/mxcli#1897: describe page X > p.mdl; exec p.mdl reported 'Replaced page' with nothing changed. On TestApp 15 of 68 pages did (Administration.Account_Overview, most WorkflowCommons pages); a second exec reported Unchanged.
cause: Three values MDL cannot state were regenerated on rebuild: Forms$TabControl.DefaultPagePointer (stored null → first tab; a stored non-first default reset too), Expression strings with a trailing newline (MDL writes expressions bare), and an empty Forms$ClientTemplate ScreenReaderLabel (written null).
file: modelsdk/canon/tabdefault.go (CarryDefaultTabPages), modelsdk/canon/unexpressed.go (CarryUnexpressed), modelsdk/canon/identity.go (Reconcile runs both after TransplantIDs)
insight: Diff the unit bytes before and after the FIRST round trip with a value-only BSON walk (key order differs on any unit an older writer sorted, and NDSL dumps hide both); the second exec is always Unchanged, so testing a re-run proves nothing. Sweep every page of a project with describe→exec and grep for Replaced — one named page in a report is usually a class.
